## Idea (what the picture must explain)
The rabbi: the Torah is already engraved inside every person (like Avraham, who knew all the Torah from within). A person has everything inside because his soul is connected to Hashem. But there are many concealments, so we learn from OUTSIDE to restore what is INSIDE. A baby is taught all the Torah in the womb and made to forget, so that he RETURNS to what he already learned - nobody learns anything new. You could not learn something for the very first time; it stays as an imprint (reshimu) that feels familiar. Each person finds over the years his own special part of the Torah - a part that was his from before; he is not inventing it.
Heroes: the GLASS SOUL-SPHERE with its golden lattice (opens, middle, end), the VEILS, the TILES that re-light existing nodes, and the two DISCS (smooth vs imprinted).

- World: a round SAGE-GREEN ROTUNDA (soft walls 0xa8c3a0, a few slim cream pilasters 0xf7f0e1) with a cream floor 0xf3ead8 and a round OCULUS in the ceiling through which soft warm light 0xfff4d6 falls. - SOUL-SPHERE: clear glass sphere ~1.2 m on a cream pedestal with teal trim; inside, a golden LATTICE = ~40-60 small glowing nodes joined by thin lines on a few concentric shells (abstract, like a constellation / geodesic net - NOT letters, NOT a scroll). Lines draw on progressively; nodes have on/dim/off states.
- THREAD: thin golden line of light from the sphere top up through the oculus; light pulses travel DOWN it.
- VEILS: 3 frosted translucent shells (white-mint 0xe6f2ec, opacity ~0.35 each) that close around the sphere like petals; behind them the lattice dims to faint lines (still visible - never gone).

- DISCS (s03): two thick round stone discs (cream stone 0xe9e0cc, teal rim) lying tilted toward camera. Left = perfectly smooth. Right = the same lattice pattern as a faint EMBOSSED relief. Golden liquid (glossy gold blobs/ribbon) pours from above on each: on the smooth one it beads and slides off the edge to the floor; on the embossed one it runs into the grooves and the whole pattern glows. Then a raking side light makes the faint relief sparkle; a tile clicks into an exact socket.
- ROW OF SOULS (s05): five spheres on pedestals in a gentle arc; each has a different lattice region glowing in its own colour (gold, teal 0x4fb0aa, coral 0xe9876a, sky 0x7fb3e0, sage 0x7fae7a). Coloured tiles stream in from the oculus light and each curves to the sphere of the same colour and clicks into a socket that was already outlined there.
